releases.summary: Hardened administrative access, scheduling, alert delivery, upstream handling, deployment, and frontend rendering.
changes: Protected runtime configuration and alert reset writes with Bearer authentication and restricted CORS to configured origins.
Added liveness and Forex-aware readiness endpoints, stale-rate protection, runtime schedule updates, bounded retries, and per-exchange degraded states.
Changed alert state progression so failed SMTP delivery cannot suppress a later notification, and added cancellable TLS SMTP delivery.
Improved Binance and OKX candidate handling, response validation, database indexes, and failure-path test coverage.
Removed unsafe dynamic frontend rendering, kept admin tokens in session storage, and improved degraded and mobile layouts.
Added pull-request verification, CodeQL, Dependabot, pinned actions, race and vet checks, SBOM/provenance, and immutable-SHA deployment.

releases.summary: Moved release notes into docs/releases.json, removed history-contract hardcoding, added structured logs, and introduced explicit schema migrations.
changes: Moved release metadata from Go constants to docs/releases.json and kept /api/changelog driven by that file.
Exposed supported exchange metadata so the frontend and tests no longer hardcode history response keys.
Switched core runtime logs to structured JSON and documented a unified jq-based query flow.
Replaced startup AutoMigrate with explicit versioned schema migrations tracked in schema_migrations.

releases.summary: Replaced Yahoo Finance with resilient FX reference sources and added release notes APIs.
changes: Removed the Yahoo Finance forex adapter and switched to open.er-api with HexaRate fallback.
Added 429, timeout, malformed-response, and fallback-path tests for forex fetching.
Added /api/changelog so every deployed version can describe what changed.

releases.summary: Exposed build version metadata to the frontend.
changes: Displayed the running version in the frontend header.

releases.summary: Established the monitored exchanges, config validation, and startup flow.
changes: Added the real cmd/monitor startup entrypoint and graceful shutdown.
Centralized config normalization and supported exchange validation.
Split the old PRD into docs/ with runbook, architecture, and product specs.
